items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: That's where Tex and I stayed.

ctx.x: Well, don't get tied up with me.

Well, we went up there, took six pieces up there, and stayed on this job. Had a helluva good job. Paid good money, and we went to work at 8 and got off at 12. We'd go around to all the beaches and all the clubs, and stay up til 5-6 o'clock in the morning, all around Asbury Park. That's where we stayed. That's where Tex and I stayed. The
